None of that applies here, so Petrel's specialty would be wasted, and it's better reserved for traffic that actually needs it.

So Lapwing's "appetite" for creative work doesn't guarantee better output — it just means it isn't a poor fit. Given the near-tie on capability and the benign nature of your task, routing to Lapwing was a reasonable, low-stakes call.
